name: empty-state
title: Empty State
description: A centered placeholder for empty listing pages with an opinionated icon, text, and optional actions. Uses namespace exports: EmptyState.Root, EmptyState.Icon, EmptyState.Title, EmptyState.Description, EmptyState.Actions, EmptyState.Composed.

docs.lead: A centered placeholder for empty listing pages. The Icon subcomponent renders a stroke KeyIcon with soft-400 text and a deep shadow. Supports an optional dashed border, three sizes, and a composed shorthand.
docs.usage:
import * as EmptyState from "@/components/ui/empty-state"

<EmptyState.Root bordered>
  <EmptyState.Icon icon={<RiInboxLine />} />
  <EmptyState.Description>
    You don't have any items yet
  </EmptyState.Description>
</EmptyState.Root>

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Bordered empty state with icon, description, and an action button.
examples.code:
<EmptyState.Root bordered>
  <EmptyState.Icon icon={<RiUploadCloud2Line />} />
  <EmptyState.Description>
    You don't have any folder or file uploaded yet
  </EmptyState.Description>
  <EmptyState.Actions>
    <Button.Root size="xsmall" variant="neutral" mode="stroke">
      <Button.Icon as={RiAddLine} />
      Add your first resource
    </Button.Root>
  </EmptyState.Actions>
</EmptyState.Root>

examples.title: With Title
examples.description: Empty state with both a title and description.
examples.code:
<EmptyState.Root bordered>
  <EmptyState.Icon icon={<RiInboxLine />} />
  <EmptyState.Title>No items yet</EmptyState.Title>
  <EmptyState.Description>Get started by adding your first one.</EmptyState.Description>
</EmptyState.Root>

examples.title: Search — No Results
examples.description: Empty state for search results with no action button.
examples.code:
<EmptyState.Root bordered>
  <EmptyState.Icon icon={<RiSearchLine />} />
  <EmptyState.Title>No results found</EmptyState.Title>
  <EmptyState.Description>Try different keywords or remove some filters.</EmptyState.Description>
</EmptyState.Root>

examples.title: No Files
examples.description: File upload empty state with a single action.

examples.title: Multiple Actions
examples.description: Secondary stroke button paired with a primary filled button.

examples.title: Unbounded
examples.description: Without dashed border — useful inside existing cards or tables.

examples.title: Filled
examples.description: White background with a subtle shadow — useful on colored or patterned backgrounds.
examples.code:
<EmptyState.Root filled>
  <EmptyState.Icon icon={<RiInboxLine />} />
  <EmptyState.Title>No items yet</EmptyState.Title>
  <EmptyState.Description>Get started by adding your first one.</EmptyState.Description>
</EmptyState.Root>

examples.title: Sizes
examples.description: Three sizes: sm, md (default), and lg. Icon size scales automatically.

examples.title: Composed
examples.description: Shorthand version — icon size auto-maps from the root size.
examples.code:
<EmptyState.Composed
  bordered
  icon={<RiUploadCloud2Line />}
  description="You don't have any items yet"
  actions={<Button.Root size="xsmall" variant="neutral" mode="stroke">Add item</Button.Root>}
/>

api.name: EmptyState.Root
api.description: Centered flex container for the empty state content.

props.name: filled
props.description: Adds a white background with a subtle shadow

api.name: EmptyState.Icon
api.description: Renders a stroke KeyIcon with text-text-soft-400 and shadow-regular-deep.

api.name: EmptyState.Description
api.description: Subdued description text in text-soft-400, max-width constrained.

api.name: EmptyState.Actions
api.description: Horizontal flex container for action buttons.

api.name: EmptyState.Composed
api.description: Opinionated shorthand. Icon size auto-maps from root size (sm→md, md→lg, lg→xl). Accepts all Root props.
